client: Marlowe Furniture
client_industry: retail
start: 2021-02
end: 2021-04
engagement: fixed
stack:

metrics:

text: Mina did a great job on our Sales KPI dashboard. She replaced 14 separate Excel sales reports with one Power BI report, which made our monthly close reporting much faster, from 3 days down to 4 hours. The work was solid and easy for our team to use.
